validation_conclusion.sa_default_budget: No validated actual-RMSE gain; both paired intervals include zero and time increased.
validation_conclusion.sa_high_budget: Mean RMSE improved but paired intervals include zero; higher search budget does not establish a robust sensing benefit.
validation_conclusion.mpc: Validated small actual-RMSE improvement in both scenarios with preserved success and safety; crossing costs five seconds and substantially more computation.

sa.caveat: Retained as the prespecified weak-gain sensing SA, not as a universal positive result.

mpc.caveat: Validated small tracking gain with a crossing-time and computation tradeoff.

rl_sensing_coefficients.rationale: Low preserves the existing coefficient; high is a 10x moderate ablation. Planner lambdas use different native cost units and are not transferred directly.

provenance: Reward magnitudes were derived from saved STEP2 development Goal trajectories only; no episode was rerun.
